description: This file defines the AppUserDetails class, which implements Spring Security's UserDetails interface to wrap user data from the User entity for authentication purposes.

classes.name: AppUserDetails
classes.description: A wrapper class implementing Spring Security's UserDetails to provide user details for authentication.

methods.name: AppUserDetails
methods.description: Constructor that initializes AppUserDetails with a User object.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the user.

methods.name: getEmail
methods.description: Returns the email of the user.

methods.name: getAuthorities
methods.description: Returns the authorities granted to the user; currently returns an empty list.

methods.name: getPassword
methods.description: Returns the password hash of the user.

methods.name: getUsername
methods.description: Returns the username, which is the user's email.

methods.name: isAccountNonExpired
methods.description: Indicates whether the account has expired; always true in this implementation.

methods.name: isAccountNonLocked
methods.description: Indicates whether the account is locked; always true here.

methods.name: isCredentialsNonExpired
methods.description: Indicates whether credentials have expired; always true.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Indicates whether the user is enabled; always true.
